purpose: Maps every clause anchor in the module to the capture file and record it was derived from. The module is the authority; this file records HOW each clause was derived so a reviewer can audit it. Nothing here is normative.

evidence_kind_legend.parsed: read directly out of a parsed capture record
evidence_kind_legend.derived: computed or inferred from parsed capture records; the inference is stated in the clause
evidence_kind_legend.contract: an authoring-contract or operator rule, not an application observation
evidence_kind_legend.spec_text: the superseded Master Spec text itself
evidence_kind_legend.defect_notice: a recorded defect in the capture, cited so the clause does not rely on it
evidence_kind_legend.recovery_limit: a capture that did not recover the value; the clause records UNKNOWN

derivation_legend.parsed: clause states what the capture states
derivation_legend.derived: clause states a consequence of what the capture states
derivation_legend.studio_normative_choice: clause fixes a value no capture declared; the clause says so inline
derivation_legend.contradiction_of_record: clause records a disagreement between capture and superseded spec text
derivation_legend.contradiction_resolution: clause replaces superseded spec text on the strength of a capture
derivation_legend.restatement_hardened: clause restates a retained anchor and adds binding detail
derivation_legend.governance: clause is authority or scope bookkeeping, not behaviour
derivation_legend.parsed+normative_choice: clause mixes parsed values with a stated Studio choice
derivation_legend.parsed+self_audit: clause reports counts measured over the capture and over this module

contradictions_of_record.claim_in_spec: composition is one closed four-value enumeration: paragraph, single_line, world_ready, cjk
contradictions_of_record.capture_says: composition is two independent axes plus a name registry
contradictions_of_record.consequence: the four-value enumeration cannot express world-ready single-line composition, which ships

contradictions_of_record.claim_in_spec: auto-size has three modes: auto_width, auto_height, fixed
contradictions_of_record.capture_says: five modes plus a separate nine-value anchor axis plus separate minimums, and truncation is a separate two-state property with its own max-lines
evidence: _greenroom_20260903/installed_exports/indesign/offline/indesign_text_model.json :: enumerations['auto sizing type enum'] has 5 members
_greenroom_20260903/installed_exports/indesign/offline/indesign_text_model.json :: enumerations['auto sizing reference enum'] has 9 members

_greenroom_20260903/installed_exports/indesign/offline/indesign_text_model.json :: classes['text frame preference'].{minimum height for auto sizing, minimum width for auto sizing, use minimum height for auto sizing, use minimum width for auto sizing}
contradictions_of_record.consequence: proportional growth is dropped entirely and a resize has no recorded anchor, so it is unreproducible

contradictions_of_record.claim_in_spec: balance ragged lines is an optional boolean mode that requires the paragraph composer
contradictions_of_record.capture_says: the attribute is typed variant and accepts an enumeration value, and its constraint is against the single-line scope, not against one named composer
evidence: _greenroom_20260903/installed_exports/indesign/offline/indesign_text_model.json :: attributes['balance ragged lines'].type == 'any / variant'; description: 'If true or set to an enumeration value, balances ragged lines. Note: Not valid with a single-line text composer.'
_greenroom_20260903/installed_exports/figma/offline/figma_object_model.json :: enums.TextWrapStyle == AUTO | BALANCE | PRETTY, a three-mode balance control in a second lineage
contradictions_of_record.consequence: a boolean control cannot express the shipped modes, and world-ready every-line composition is wrongly excluded
